# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [A tanker incident at the US blockade line tests oil's calm as Iran stages tankers at Kharg](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 23, 2026. Is Iran testing the US blockade? UKMTO reported a tanker incident involving military forces in the Gulf of Oman on Sunday, and Iranian media claimed two tankers hit mines east of Hormuz. Neither report is confirmed, and oil futures barely moved early Monday.
- [Upstream: Vår Energi agrees to buy ConocoPhillips' Norway business for $4.425 billion](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Regulation: COP31 ends without an agreed deal after a fight over fossil fuel language](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Midstream: San Mateo Midstream upsizes its notes to $850 million at 7.125%](https://uticamidstream.com/#sanmateo)
- [Gas and LNG: US LNG feedgas eases from a record as Sabine Pass flows dip](https://uticamidstream.com/#lng)
